reference.name: Haneda Airport P2 Parking Garage
reference.attribution: Official P2 floor-map PDF, page 5. The operator lists 2,315 total spaces and the full 5F as a 396-space reservation level.
reference.note: Two basement and four above-ground modeled decks use the 5F reference template. Modeled bay counts and 4.2 m floor spacing are emulation parameters, distinct from the operator's 2,315-space facility count. Only five project bays on modeled 2F report live occupancy.
